rationale: The agent verified identity via the provided email, which mapped to a single user. All actions were performed only on that user’s orders. The agent inspected orders and product details before making changes, obtained explicit confirmation prior to each write (address change, item exchange with clear price difference and payment method, and order cancellation), and used the correct tools. The outcomes reflected the tool results accurately, including the updated address, exchanged item and charge, and the cancellation with refund. Minor generic statements (e.g., 5–7 business day refund window, “exchange can only be done once”) did not contradict tool outputs and did not affect the correctness of actions. Overall, the requests were completed in line with policy.
